facts.en: Completed a BA in Social Studies at Fictional Institute D087 in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构院校 D087 完成社会研究文学学士学位。

facts.en: Worked as a service feedback coordinator at Fictional Advice Centre D087 from 2022-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-02 至 2026-08 在虚构咨询中心 D087 担任服务反馈协调员。

facts.en: Compiled voluntary feedback forms and removed contact details before producing team summaries.
facts.zh: 汇编自愿反馈表，并在制作团队摘要前删除联系方式。

facts.en: Used spreadsheet filters and counts to summarize response categories, retaining missing-response labels.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格筛选及计数汇总回应类别，并保留缺失回应标签。

facts.en: With a service manager, compared feedback from 2 reception periods around a 2025-04 signage change.
facts.zh: 与服务经理合作，比较 2025-04 标识变更前后 2 个接待期间的反馈。

facts.en: Positive navigation responses numbered 28 of 40 returned forms before the change and 35 of 44 afterward; only returned forms are counted.
facts.zh: 变更前收回的 40 份表格中有 28 份给予正面导航评价，变更后收回的 44 份中有 35 份；仅计收回表格。

facts.en: Visitors were not randomized, response rates are unavailable, and staffing changed; no causal or population-wide conclusion was drawn.
facts.zh: 访客未随机分组，回应率不可得，且人员配置变化；未得出因果或总体结论。

facts.en: No significance test, confidence interval or power analysis was performed for that comparison.
facts.zh: 该比较未执行显著性检验、置信区间或功效分析。

facts.en: Presented descriptive tables with caveats to the service manager, who decided whether to change service arrangements.
facts.zh: 向服务经理展示附局限说明的描述表格，由经理决定是否改变服务安排。

facts.en: Prepared a 2026-01 feedback-coding guide that the manager approved for routine use.
facts.zh: 2026-01 准备反馈编码指南，由经理批准用于常规工作。

facts.en: Drafted a randomized-test proposal in 2026-05 as a learning exercise; it was neither approved nor conducted.
facts.zh: 2026-05 以学习练习方式起草随机试验提案；未获批准或执行。

facts.en: Completed a 2024-11 introductory statistics module using fictional survey data, not a professional research credential.
facts.zh: 2024-11 使用虚构调查数据完成入门统计模块，并非专业研究资格。

facts.en: At the 2025-09 peak, tracked feedback for 5 service desks; the regular 2026-08 scope was 3.
facts.zh: 在 2025-09 高峰期跟踪 5 个服务台反馈；2026-08 常规范围为 3 个。

facts.en: Volunteered for Fictional Nature Drawing Circle V087 from 2023-03 to 2023-09 on weekends alongside paid work.
facts.zh: 2023-03 至 2023-09 在有偿任职期间，周末为虚构自然绘画社团 V087 志愿服务。

facts.en: For the circle, counted art-material packs; it was not a participant-outcome study.
facts.zh: 为该社团清点美术材料包；并非参与者成果研究。

facts.en: Maintains a personal collection of imaginary railway timetables.
facts.zh: 保留个人虚构铁路时刻表收藏。

facts.en: A draft summary calls the navigation difference statistically significant and caused by signage, without analytical evidence for either assertion.
facts.zh: 一份摘要草稿称导航差异具有统计显著性且由标识导致，但两种断言均无分析证据。

facts.en: Kept raw category definitions and calculation notes so a reviewer could reproduce descriptive counts.
facts.zh: 保留原始类别定义及计算备注，使审核者可复算描述性计数。

facts.en: Routed free-text complaints to the designated service lead instead of diagnosing individuals or resolving cases independently.
facts.zh: 将自由文本投诉转交指定服务负责人，而非诊断个人或独立解决个案。
